## Boundary and documented goal

Reproduced on main `eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6`, Node v24.19.0/Linux, with the exact committed lockfile and `@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.13`. Source blobs were verified against GitHub and rebuilt distribution bytes matched the committed distribution. This is a real installed-CLI result using a disposable Git repository and items created by the actual SDK, not a mocked host.

[README lines 73–76](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6/README.md#L73-L76) specify file-overlap ranking first, followed by lifecycle/priority and existing limits/packing. The [feature owner pm-context-ax7z](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6/.agents/pm/features/pm-context-ax7z.toon) and merged [PR #151](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/pull/151) describe the same file-focused selection goal.

## Reproduction and controls

Create nine Task items in a fresh tracker, all with:
- status `open`
- title `"X".repeat(100)`
- no body
- equal-length IDs

One item, `focus-best-000`, has priority 4 and a file link to `src`. The other eight, `focus-next-000` through `focus-next-007`, have priority 0 and a file link to `src/a.ts`.

Run the installed extension:

```sh
pm context-pack --files src/a.ts --files src/b.ts --without-neighborhood --format json
pm context-pack --files src/a.ts --files src/b.ts --without-neighborhood --format json --max-items 1
pm context-pack --files src/a.ts --files src/b.ts --without-neighborhood --format json --max-items 1 --id focus-best-000
pm context-pack --files src/a.ts --files src/b.ts --without-neighborhood --format json --max-items 1 --limit 1
```

Results:
1. No item cap: `focus-best-000` is first, with `matched_files: ["src/a.ts","src/b.ts"]`; the eight others each match only `src/a.ts`
2. `--max-items 1`: only `focus-next-000` is emitted
3. Same budget + explicit best ID: `focus-best-000` is emitted
4. Same budget + `--limit 1`: `focus-best-000` is emitted

All nine identity projections cost exactly 29 estimated tokens; their summary/full projections each cost 32. The one-slot budget is 220. The highest-overlap item comfortably fits; its loss is not a legitimate oversized-item fallback or a smaller-item optimization. Nine required identities total 261 tokens, exposing the ordering error during budget selection.

Minimal deterministic public-helper reproduction:

```js
import { buildContextPack, createSdkPacker } from "./dist/index.js";

const best = {
  id: "focus-best-000", title: "X".repeat(100),
  type: "Task", status: "open", priority: 4,
  files: [{ path: "src" }],
};
const next = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `focus-next-00${i}`, title: "X".repeat(100),
  type: "Task", status: "open", priority: 0,
  files: [{ path: "src/a.ts" }],
}));
const globalRelevanceOrder = [...next, best];
const pack = buildContextPack([best, ...next], {
  fileFocus: { root: "/repo", files: ["src/a.ts", "src/b.ts"], refresh: "" },
  neighborhood: false,
  maxItems: 1,
  packer: createSdkPacker(globalRelevanceOrder, globalRelevanceOrder),
});
console.log(pack.items.map(item => item.id));
// Actual: ["focus-next-000"]; expected: ["focus-best-000"]
```

The same failure occurs through the real CLI with SDK-created records, without injecting a packer. Both positive controls above pass before the overlap-selection assertion fails.

## Cause and impact

[Command setup](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6/index.ts#L1495-L1502) builds the packer from the entire corpus's general relevance ordering. [File selection](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6/index.ts#L522-L529) ranks by overlap, but [createSdkPacker](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/blob/eac19c5bf3ceb7a82f1e958ac97bef4d9af16fc6/index.ts#L1213-L1247) sends the earlier general ranks to token-budget selection. When not all required identities fit, an item matching fewer changed files can displace the best-overlap item. The final slice preserves the order only among survivors.

An agent requesting a small file-focused pack can therefore lose the item covering the most of its working set. The matching and tracking data remain correct; no data loss or tracker corruption was observed.

## Suggested acceptance

- Preserve file-focused ordering through budget-constrained focus selection
- Cover equal-cost candidates whose combined identities exceed the budget
- Assert the highest-overlap item survives when it individually fits
- Keep the explicit-ID and limit-one controls and existing neighborhood behavior
- Verify JSON and explain report the same emitted selection

## Duplicate and scope check

All 152 pre-existing issues/PRs across all states and current canonical PM issues/features were reviewed. Closed [#136](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-context/issues/136) concerns dependency-kind/direction projection, not ranking or packing. The relevant feature owner is pm-context-ax7z. All 17 authored file-focus tests pass; this is an independent gap in budget-pressure coverage. No source implementation changes, dependency-pin changes, live integrations, or publication were performed.
